name: modsmith
description: Create, study, audit, fix and port Minecraft Java mods (NeoForge, Fabric, Forge) with good engineering practices and a guided path from idea to playable mod.

interface.shortDescription: Minecraft mod development and maintenance: plan, build, audit, fix and port.
interface.longDescription: Modsmith helps create, understand, fix, audit and port Minecraft Java mods (NeoForge, Fabric, Forge, multiloader). New mods follow a guided path from an idea to playable milestones; existing mods get a study, a prioritized CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW audit and fixes in safe batches.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Minecraft mod and tell me what to fix first.
Create a new NeoForge mod that adds tiered furnaces.
My mod crashes on the dedicated server, here is the log.
